import os
import pandas as pd
from sklearn.model_selection import StratifiedShuffleSplit
from sklearn.feature_extraction.text import TfidfVectorizer
from sklearn.linear_model import LogisticRegression
from sklearn.metrics import log_loss
from scipy.sparse import hstack

os.makedirs("./submission", exist_ok=True)

train = pd.read_csv("./input/train.csv")
test = pd.read_csv("./input/test.csv")
sample_sub = pd.read_csv("./input/sample_submission.csv")

# Initialize vectorizers with distinct analytical lenses
vec_char = TfidfVectorizer(
    analyzer="char", ngram_range=(3, 6), min_df=2, max_df=0.85, sublinear_tf=True
)
vec_charwb = TfidfVectorizer(
    analyzer="char_wb", ngram_range=(2, 5), min_df=2, max_df=0.85, sublinear_tf=True
)
vec_word = TfidfVectorizer(
    analyzer="word", ngram_range=(1, 3), min_df=2, max_df=0.85, sublinear_tf=True
)

train_text = train["text"].values

# Fit vectorizers on the training corpus
X_char = vec_char.fit_transform(train_text)
X_charwb = vec_charwb.fit_transform(train_text)
X_word = vec_word.fit_transform(train_text)
X_train_full = hstack([X_char, X_charwb, X_word])
y_train = train["author"].values

# Hold-out validation split
sss = StratifiedShuffleSplit(n_splits=1, test_size=0.1, random_state=42)
for tr_idx, val_idx in sss.split(X_train_full, y_train):
    X_tr, X_val = X_train_full[tr_idx], X_train_full[val_idx]
    y_tr, y_val = y_train[tr_idx], y_train[val_idx]

# Train classifier
clf = LogisticRegression(
    multi_class="multinomial", solver="lbfgs", C=1.0, max_iter=5000, tol=1e-4
)
clf.fit(X_tr, y_tr)

# Validate
val_probs = clf.predict_proba(X_val)
print(f"Validation Multi-class Log-Loss: {log_loss(y_val, val_probs):.6f}")

# Generate test predictions
test_text = test["text"].values
X_test = hstack(
    [
        vec_char.transform(test_text),
        vec_charwb.transform(test_text),
        vec_word.transform(test_text),
    ]
)
test_probs = clf.predict_proba(X_test)

# Format submission
sub = pd.DataFrame(test_probs, columns=clf.classes_, index=test["id"])
sub = sub[sample_sub.columns[1:]]  # Ensure correct column order: EAP, HPL, MWS
sub.index.name = sample_sub.index.name
sub.to_csv("./submission/submission.csv", index=False)
print("Submission saved successfully.")
